name: Erwin Rommel
passive: +20% speed to all ground units. +10% DPS to Tank Destroyers.
active: Ghost Division: All German units become invisible to enemy defenses for 8 seconds after breaching the first wall. Defenses cannot target them during this window.
note: Rommel was famous for rapid unpredictable advances that outpaced enemy intelligence. His 7th Panzer Division moved so fast it was called the Ghost Division.

name: Heinz Guderian
passive: +25% movement speed to all tanks. Barracks trains ground units 15% faster.
active: Blitzkrieg Master: For 20 seconds all German tanks ignore walls entirely - they pass through as if walls do not exist. Destroys wall HP on passage.
note: Guderian invented and perfected armored warfare doctrine. His concept of fast deep penetration warfare became the foundation of modern armored tactics.

name: Erich von Manstein
passive: +15% HP to all Heavy Tanks. +10% DPS to all ground units when attacking from the flank zones.
active: Backhand Blow: Instantly teleports all units in one deployment zone to an adjacent zone. Catches defenders off guard and reshuffles attack vectors mid-raid.
note: Manstein was considered the finest operational mind of WW2. His Backhand Blow tactic - allowing enemy advance then striking flanks - was tactically brilliant.

name: Albert Kesselring
passive: +20% HP to all German air units. AA Towers on home base gain +15% fire rate.
active: Mediterranean Iron: All German air units in the second wave arrive 10 seconds early bypassing the 50% ground loss trigger if ground losses reach 35% instead.
note: Kesselring commanded Luftwaffe forces and later Italian theater ground forces. Famous for conducting brilliant defensive campaigns with limited resources.

name: Otto Carius
passive: +30% DPS to all Heavy Tanks. Heavy Tanks gain immunity to the first Critical Hit taken.
active: Tiger Ace: Select one Heavy Tank in the formation. That tank becomes Otto Carius himself - gains 3x HP, 2x DPS, and an aura that boosts adjacent units +20% DPS for the entire raid.
note: Otto Carius was one of the most successful tank commanders in history with over 150 confirmed kills. His Tiger I became legendary on the Eastern Front.

name: Georgy Zhukov
passive: +20% HP to all Soviet units. Resource buildings gain +15% HP on home base.
active: Soviet Hammer: Call in an artillery barrage on the enemy base. 5 random buildings take 2000 damage each. Happens instantly at raid start before units advance.
note: Zhukov was the most decorated Soviet commander and architect of the great offensives that crushed Nazi Germany. The Battle of Kursk and Berlin fell under his direction.

name: Ivan Konev
passive: +15% DPS to all Medium and Heavy Tanks. +10% movement speed to all ground units.
active: Steel Flood: Deploy 5 additional T-34/85 units for free from the North zone. These units do not count toward Army Camp capacity for this raid only.
note: Konev commanded the First Ukrainian Front and raced Zhukov to Berlin. His armored offensives were characterized by massive tank concentrations and relentless pressure.

name: Vasily Chuikov
passive: +25% HP to all Soviet units. Home base defense towers gain +10% DPS.
active: Not One Step Back: For 30 seconds all Soviet ground units cannot be killed - they fight at 1 HP until the ability expires then any unit below 100 HP is destroyed simultaneously.
note: Chuikov commanded the 62nd Army at Stalingrad and refused to yield the city. His close-quarters tactics - hugging the enemy to neutralize artillery - were revolutionary.

name: Konstantin Rokossovsky
passive: +20% DPS to all units. SPG units gain +25% range.
active: Operation Bagration: All four deployment zones activate simultaneously with a speed boost - units from all active zones gain +30% speed for the first 45 seconds of the raid.
note: Rokossovsky planned and executed Operation Bagration - the largest Soviet offensive of WW2 that destroyed Army Group Centre. Coordinated multi-front attacks were his specialty.

name: Alexander Vasilevsky
passive: +15% to all unit stats simultaneously. Research Point gains increased by 10%.
active: Strategic Reserve: Once per raid call in 3 units of any type already in your roster as emergency reinforcements from the East zone regardless of which zones are active.
note: Vasilevsky coordinated Soviet strategic operations across multiple fronts simultaneously. He planned more major operations than any other Soviet commander.

name: George S. Patton
passive: +25% movement speed to all ground units. +15% DPS to Medium and Heavy Tanks.
active: Ivory Handle Pistols: Patton personally leads the charge - all US ground units gain +30% DPS and +20% speed for 15 seconds. Cannot be blocked or countered.
note: Patton was the fastest-moving army commander in history. His Third Army advanced faster than any force in the European Theater. Feared by German commanders above all others.

name: Dwight D. Eisenhower
passive: +10% to all unit stats. Alliance war raid bonuses increased by 15%.
active: Supreme Command: Choose any one enemy defense tower and disable it completely for the entire raid. It cannot fire. Represents Eisenhower coordinating precision intelligence strikes.
note: Eisenhower coordinated the largest military alliance in history. His ability to manage competing personalities and direct resources made Operation Overlord possible.

name: Omar Bradley
passive: +20% HP to all US ground units. Army Camp capacity increased by 10 for the raid.
active: GI Doctrine: Medium Tanks cost 50% less Oil this raid. All ground units gain +15% HP from Bradley inspiring the common soldier.
note: Bradley commanded 1.3 million men - the largest American field army ever. He was beloved by his troops for understanding the common soldier perspective.

name: Curtis LeMay
passive: +30% DPS to all US air units. Air units trigger at 40% ground losses instead of 50%.
active: Strategic Air Command: All US air units arrive simultaneously in one massive wave rather than in launch order. Every aircraft hits the base at the same second.
note: LeMay transformed US strategic bombing into a precision science. His doctrine of maximum concentrated air power in minimum time defined US air doctrine through the Cold War.

name: Creighton Abrams
passive: +25% DPS and +20% HP to all Heavy Tanks. The M1A2 Abrams gains a unique gold commander hatch skin.
active: Abrams Doctrine: The heaviest tank in your formation becomes the Commander Tank - it gains 4x HP, spawns with full armor, and its destruction triggers a free replacement unit mid-raid.
note: Abrams was the finest American tank commander of WW2 and later Army Chief of Staff. The M1 Abrams MBT was named in his honor - the highest tribute to an armor officer.

name: Bernard Montgomery
passive: +15% DPS to all British units. Defense towers on home base gain +10% HP.
active: Master of the Set Piece: Before raid launch reveal the exact HP of every enemy defense tower. Formation planning becomes perfectly informed. Lasts for the planning phase only.
note: Montgomery was the most methodical British commander of WW2. His set-piece battle doctrine involved meticulous preparation and overwhelming force at the chosen point of attack.

name: Winston Churchill
passive: +20% HP to all British units. Finest Hour mechanic triggers at 30% CC HP instead of 25%.
active: We Shall Never Surrender: When any British building is destroyed this raid all remaining British defense towers gain +5% fire rate stacking up to +40% total. Punishes attackers for every building they take.
note: Churchill was not a battlefield commander but his Iron will shaped British military doctrine. As a young man he participated in the last British cavalry charge. His defiance defined the British war effort.

name: Harold Alexander
passive: +15% to all unit stats when fighting alongside alliance members in war raids.
active: Coalition Warfare: Request one donated unit from alliance War Bunker to deploy in your formation for this raid at no Oil cost. The unit fights alongside your army.
note: Alexander commanded Allied forces in the Mediterranean and was famous for his ability to coordinate fractious Allied commanders. He was the consummate coalition warfare officer.

name: Arthur Harris
passive: +35% DPS to all British bomber and ground attack aircraft.
active: Area Bombing: British bombers in this raid each make two passes instead of one. Each bomber drops payload twice on different targets. Doubles bomber raid effectiveness.
note: Air Chief Marshal Harris commanded RAF Bomber Command and prosecuted the strategic bombing campaign against Germany. His doctrine of area bombing remains controversial but effective.

name: Francis de Guingand
passive: +10% to all unit stats. RP earned from this raid increased by 25%.
active: Operational Planning: The enemy base Intel is fully revealed for this raid regardless of Intel Center level. See exact resource amounts defense HP and building positions.
note: De Guingand was Montgomery chief of staff and one of the finest operational planners of WW2. His behind-the-scenes coordination made Montgomery battlefield successes possible.

name: Isoroku Yamamoto
passive: +25% DPS to all Japanese air units. Kamikaze Strike available from Air Hangar Lv1 instead of Lv3.
active: Tora Tora Tora: All Japanese air units deploy at raid start simultaneously with the ground units rather than waiting for the 50% trigger. Full combined arms from second zero.
note: Yamamoto planned and executed the Pearl Harbor attack and the Midway operation. He understood airpower before any other naval commander. Famous quote: I fear we have awakened a sleeping giant.

name: Tomoyuki Yamashita
passive: +20% speed to all Japanese ground units. +15% DPS when attacking from flank zones.
active: Lightning Conquest: All Japanese units in the formation gain free movement through the enemy outer wall for 10 seconds. The wall is not damaged - units phase through it. Represents Yamashita outflanking Singapore defenses.
note: Yamashita conquered Malaya and Singapore in 70 days with a force half the size of the defenders. His Lightning War through difficult jungle terrain was considered impossible by British commanders.

name: Hideki Tojo
passive: +15% to all Japanese unit stats. Training time for all units reduced by 20%.
active: Iron Will: Japanese units cannot trigger Banzai Charge involuntarily this raid. Instead the player manually activates Banzai Charge on all units simultaneously at a chosen moment dealing maximum coordinated damage.
note: Tojo was Prime Minister and Army Minister simultaneously. His administrative iron discipline kept Japanese military production running under extreme resource constraints throughout the war.

name: Mitsuru Ushijima
passive: +30% HP to all Japanese units. Home base defense towers gain +20% HP.
active: Last Stronghold: All Japanese units in the raid gain regenerating HP - recovering 2% max HP per second for the first 60 seconds of the raid. Represents Ushijima tenacious defense doctrine.
note: Ushijima commanded the defense of Okinawa and inflicted the heaviest US naval casualties of the Pacific War. His in-depth defense doctrine made Okinawa the bloodiest Pacific battle.

name: Jinichi Kusaka
passive: +30% DPS to all Japanese air units. Air units gain +15% speed.
active: Divine Wind: The Kamikaze Strike this raid deals 8x damage instead of 5x and cannot be intercepted by CIWS or SAM systems. The sacrifice is absolute.
note: Kusaka commanded Japanese naval air forces and oversaw the formal Kamikaze program. Under his direction the Kamikaze corps became the most effective anti-ship weapon Japan possessed in the final year of the war.
